items.title: Amgen third quarter sales rise 8%, led by cholesterol, cancer drugs
items.summary: Nov 3 (Reuters) - Amgen on Tuesday said third-quarter sales rose 8%, led by demand for cholesterol drug Repatha and newer medicines Imdelltra for lung cancer and ‌rare disease therapy Uplizna, as the company moves ahead with development of its high-profile experimental ‌weight-loss drug MariTide. The California-based drugmaker's adjusted earnings rose 14% from a year earlier to $6.
